methodology.aggregate: Arithmetic mean over material-level metrics; 8 channels weighted equally.
methodology.bc_sampling: 348x348 decoded BC textures sampled to 1024x1024 with bilinear wrap.
methodology.lpips: LPIPS v0.1, AlexNet/ImageNet trunk, diffuse RGB in sRGB space mapped to [-1,1]; arithmetic mean over 24 materials. Lower is better.
